title: Puzzle 3d Selectable Hover Inspector
description: Make puzzle 3D objects, vortices, and attractions selectable and hoverable in the canvas; show full details in the inspector with editable fields.
summary: Fixed vortex selection in the document and made vortices hoverable/selectable in 3D and document. Root cause: selection commands only called notifySnapshot() (viewport store) and never emit(), so the declarative inspector/document panels stayed stale. Added Puzzle3dPlayShellController.notifySelection() (notifySnapshot + emit) and routed setSelection/setSelectedId/noteSelection/deleteSelection through it; patchFixture emits on structural edits and only snapshots on pose-only changes. Verified with a real bubbling DOM click that clicking a vortex tree row selects the vortex (0 objects / 1 vortex), not the parent object, and object rows still select the object; inspector + summary update accordingly. 3D vortex hover (onPointerOver/Out with stopPropagation -> hovered mesh style) and selected styling confirmed in the viewport source. Replaced a misused ui/react <Label> (crashed on undefined id) with a native <label> in the playground field renderer. Restored the data-e2e-selected probe overlay (selected label + lod/proximity/connect/indirect counts) in the puzzle 3D play viewport host, which had been dropped during the scene single-index consolidation and is required by the play e2e harness. Updated the play vitest 'selection commands refresh viewport store and declarative panels' unit test to assert selection now bumps shell generation; all 13 unit tests pass. Note: puzzle/3d/play/e2e was being deleted/restructured concurrently by the THOROUGH-BOARD-TO-PUZZLE2D-RENAME effort during this session, so e2e specs could not be run to completion here; the restored data-e2e-selected marker keeps the selection e2e contract intact.
